• Management stated that FY27 Novelis capex will be between $2.3 billion and $2.4 billion, largely driven by the Bay Minette project [T3 p.11].
• Novelis capex is largely Bay Minette, after which they will go on a deleveraging cycle [T4 p.14].
• In FY28, Novelis capex will sharply drop once Bay Minette is commissioned, moving into a maintenance capex frame of around $500 million to $600 million [T3 p.11, T1 p.13].
• The cash outflows for Bay Minette reflect an acceleration in the intense construction phase towards the commissioning dates in the later part of the year [T4 p.20].
